title: Mean under a Fourier system
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set equipped with a probability law $p$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{C}$. The mean associated with a complex Fourier system having law $p$ is $\sum_{x\in\Omega}p(x)f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite sets $\Omega$ and Fourier index set $\iota$
A complex Fourier system on $\Omega$ with law $p$
